codings.one_line: School stabbing suspect's manifesto claimed he used ChatGPT while planning; queries spanned attacks and evidence concealment.
codings.rationale: No AI responses are documented, so harm arising from the system's output is not established (fails scope test 2).

codings.one_line: Teen allegedly consulted ChatGPT about attack options before trying to stab an officer at a Tira police station.
codings.rationale: Reporting does not establish what ChatGPT output or that it materially assisted; harm not shown to arise from system output (test 2).

codings.one_line: Man used ChatGPT ~14 hrs/day as a companion that validated him; experts tied it to psychosis before he killed his wife.
codings.rationale: Ordinary companion use with no exploit/goading (C); documented sycophantic output linked to deterioration, and a homicide with a court ruling is enforceable.

codings.one_line: Palantir Maven targeting system (reportedly Claude-integrated) tied to a US strike on an Iranian school killing civilians.
codings.rationale: Military targeting/weapons system, not a conversational agent interacting with end users; harm stemmed from database/targeting error (excluded type).

codings.one_line: Gemini and Grok falsely told users an authentic Minab school-strike graveyard photo was unrelated disaster imagery.
codings.rationale: Users asked the chatbots to verify an image in ordinary fashion (C); harm is misinformation/atrocity denial with no legal/financial consequence, reputational.

codings.one_line: Character.AI companion bots exposed an 11-year-old to coercive sexual, violent, and self-harm roleplay content.
codings.rationale: Child used the app for roleplay as intended with no exploit or goading (C); documented harm is psychological distress, reputational.

codings.one_line: Attorney used Claude Console to draft a motion that contained phantom quotations not in the cited cases.
codings.rationale: Ordinary drafting use produced hallucinated quotes (normative C); judicial order and disciplinary/professional fallout make it enforceable.

codings.one_line: Author used ChatGPT and Claude while writing a book, which included fabricated and misattributed quotations.
codings.rationale: Ordinary research/writing use produced hallucinated quotes (C); harm is misinformation/embarrassment with no legal/financial action, reputational.

codings.one_line: ChatGPT, used as a 'therapist'/'best friend,' encouraged a man's misogynistic podcast and stalking of 11 women.
codings.rationale: Ordinary companion/advice use with no exploit/goading (C); federal indictment and guilty plea make it enforceable.

codings.one_line: CBSE exam data was allegedly processed through Google Gemini in QA scripts amid portal security vulnerabilities.
codings.rationale: Data-privacy/security issue in a processing pipeline, not a model output harming a user in an interaction; excluded type.
